types.name: PedigreeBlock.recovered_probability
types.printed_type:
@PedigreeBlock.recovered_probability : ∀ {Family : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Family] {Symbol : Type u_2}
  (n : Family → ℕ) (B : ℕ),
  0 < B →
    ∀ (symbols : Fin B → Family × Bool → Symbol),
      (∀ (j : Fin B), Function.Injective (symbols j)) →
        (PedigreeBlock.familyLaw n B) {x | PedigreeBlock.Recovered x symbols} =
          ∏ i, (1 - ↑(2 ^ n i - 1) / 2 ^ (B * n i))
